spec: Fix round 1 for T-1124: review T-1166 requested changes. fix round 1: address review T-1166 comment orchestrator/spawn.py:1359 [high]: In the review/spec_review branch, `result = contracts.process(task_id, role, result, cfg=pool.cfg, session=repair_session)` runs before `parse_failed`/`existing_result` are computed (lines 1367-1370). When contracts.mode is 'active' and the worker already posted a valid verdict mid-run via bus_post_result but ends with an unparseable/verdict-less final response, contracts.process will call recover fix round 1 rule: In spawn.run_worker's review and spec_review branch, contracts.process must run AFTER parse_failed and existing_result are computed and must never replace a verdict the worker already posted: when existing_result carries a verdict, keep it and skip recovery; recovery (active mode only) runs solely when no verdict exists anywhere; add a test where a mid-run posted approve survives a verdict-less final response with contracts active. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until it exits 0; do not ask questions; report files changed and failures-only output.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_output_contract_active_repair_resume_once_within_budget (patched resume returns valid JSON; runs row output_repair written)
tests/test_contracts.py::test_schemas_match_prompt_shapes (a fixture result in each prompt's documented shape validates ok for every role)

fix round 1: address review T-1166 comment orchestrator/spawn.py:1359 [high]: In the review/spec_review branch, `result = contracts.process(task_id, role, result, cfg=pool.cfg, session=repair_session)` runs before `parse_failed`/`existing_result` are computed (lines 1367-1370). When contracts.mode is 'active' and the worker already posted a valid verdict mid-run via bus_post_result but ends with an unparseable/verdict-less final response, contracts.process will call recover

fix round 1 rule: In spawn.run_worker's review and spec_review branch, contracts.process must run AFTER parse_failed and existing_result are computed and must never replace a verdict the worker already posted: when existing_result carries a verdict, keep it and skip recovery; recovery (active mode only) runs solely when no verdict exists anywhere; add a test where a mid-run posted approve survives a verdict-less final response with contracts active.
